tapDrill.title: Tap drill size
tapDrill.fineNote: * fine thread. Empty engagement uses the default (75% cut, 65% forming).
tapDrill.warnHigh: Engagement is above the usual range. Higher tap breakage risk and torque. Consider a larger drill.
tapDrill.warnLow: Engagement is too low. The thread may be shallow with reduced strength. Consider a smaller drill.
tapDrill.noteCut: Formula: D − 0.01299 · P · %. Use 60–70% engagement for hard or gummy materials, up to 75–80% for soft ones.
tapDrill.noteForm: Formula: D − 0.0068 · P · %. Forming taps need ductile material and lubrication. Check the tool maker's recommendation.

comp.title: Offset after measuring
comp.tolHint: If you enter min and max sizes, the calculator aims for the middle of the tolerance zone.
comp.noChange: Size is on target, no correction needed.
comp.removeMore: Another {{v}} {{u}} must be removed from the size.
comp.removeLess: Too much removed by {{v}} {{u}}. Leave more material.
comp.note: The sign depends on your control and how the offset is stored (radius or length wear). On the first correction verify the direction with a trial pass.

trig.title: Trigonometry
trig.rightHint: Enter two values including at least one side. The right angle is at vertex C. a is opposite α, b is opposite β.
trig.needMore: Enter at least two values including one side (and valid values).
trig.obliqueHint: Enter three values including at least one side. Side a is opposite angle A, and so on.
trig.ambiguous: The data gives two possible triangles.
trig.needMoreOblique: Not enough data or the triangle does not exist. Enter three values including one side.
